entries.title: A task's Activity leaves nothing out
entries.body: A task's Activity now lists what the app did for it, such as your approval to merge or a merge that could not run. Your reply under a card reads as your own words. Smaller events fold under the line they led to, and the line opens to show them.

picture.alt: A task's Activity with a report line opened to the update folded under it, and a reply under a card in the captain's own words
